lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel clusters are arranged in a repeating grid-like pattern posterior to the gills and above the pectoral fin insertion point.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a distinct matrix of high-intensity anchor nodes across the visible lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature runs horizontally across the upper third of the flank, displaying a sharp transition from high-luminance pixels on the dorsal edge to deep shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high concentration of small, high-luminance blobs that decrease in diameter toward the trailing edge of the fin.
